definicoes_originais: (cmp. b. h. אֵלֹון oak, v. אֵלָה) tree.
notas_originais: Shebi. I, 1, a. e. שדה הא' a field containing at least three trees within a distance of a S’ah (v. סְאָה). Ib. 3 א' סרק bearing no edible fruit, opp. א' מאכל.—Pes. 112 a (prov.) אם בקשת וכ' if you desire to be strangled, be hanged on a large tree, (if you must refer to an authority, select a good one).— Pl. אִילָּנֹות, const. אִילָּנֵי. Shebi. I, 2. Gen. R. s. 16; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: árvore; equivalente aramaico de אִילָּן; plurais diversos.
notas_originais: Targ. Gen. I, 11; a. fr.—Ab. Zar. 50 b, v. ברי ch.— Pl. אִילָנִין, אִילָנַיָּיא, אִילָנַיָּא, אִילָנֵי, אִלָ'. Targ. Gen. II, 5; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 12 מתקריין וכ' (insert פיריהון) א' fruits are named after the trees. B. Bath. 16 b; a. fr.—Lev. R. s. 5 א' דסדום, v. אמבוניא.—[קלא א', תלא א', v. s. קְלָא a. תְּלָא respectively.]
, v. אָלִיס
, v. אִלְצָרִין

verbetes.glosa_atual: navio; embarcação; jangada; também, em sentido figurado, a carcaça de uma ave.
notas_originais: êlippu) ship, raft. Targ. Jon. I, 3; a. e.—Lev. R. s. 12, beg. כהדא א' like the ship tossed about on high sea. Koh. R. to III, 2 (prov.) at the time thou tiest thy Lulab (for the Feast of Booths) קטר אלפך tie thy ship (cease navigation). Ab. Zar. 10 b ווי לה לאי' וכ' woe to the ship which leades without having paid its toll (of a convert who died before circumcision).—Trnsf. the body of a chicken ( chest-bone resembling a ship). Lam. R. to I, 1 נסבית הדין אי' וכ' (רבתי) I took for myself this ship (of the chicken), for in a ship I came &c.— Pl. אִילְפַיָּא. Targ. Ps. CIV, 26; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: Ilfa, nome próprio de um amora.
notas_originais: Taan. 21 a; a. fr. [In. Talm. Y. חילפיי]. R. Hash. 17 b אילְפָי וא"ל א' Ilfay or, some say, Ilfa (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.)
, v. preced.
v. אַיָּלָה

verbetes.glosa_atual: Ayelet; localidade a aproximadamente um dia de viagem ao sul de Jerusalém.
notas_originais: אֵילַת) Ayeleth, one day’s journey south of Jerusalem. Maas. Sh. V, 2; Bets. 5 a עלת ed. (Ms. M. איילת); R. Hash. 31 b אילת ed. (Ms. M. עַיֶּילֶת; Ms. L. עלת corr. into עיי'; Ms. 2 עגלת; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). [Bets. a. R. Hash. l. c. read מן הדרום for מן הצפון a. vice versa.] Cmp. אַיָּל.
Targ. Jer. XIV, 5; a. e. Cant. R. to II, 9; a. e.—א' דשחרא (v. אַיָּלָה) morning dawn. Y. Ber. I, 2 c; a. e.— Pl. אַיָּילָתָא, אַיָּילָאתָא. Targ. Ps. XXIX, 9; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: sentir aversão ou medo; infundir respeito ou temor; advertir testemunhas.
definicoes_originais: (√או, v. אֵיבָה) to feel aversion, fright.
(denom. of אֵימָה; with על) to impress with awe, forewarn (witnesses).
notas_originais: Denomin. אֵימָה.
R. Hash. 20 a מְאַיְּימִין על העדים we may try to intimidate &c. Yoma 4 b לְאַיֵּים עליו to impress him. Sot. I, 4; a. e.
, v. אֲמָא

mãe; em uso figurado, a polpa de fruta com caroço.
definicoes_originais: trnsf. the flesh of a stone fruit.
notas_originais: my mother; v. אַבָּא. Targ. Gen. III, 20; a. fr.—Ber. 18 b אֵימא לה לא' tell my mother; a. fr.—א' זקינה grandmother. Meg. 27 b

Sabb. 143 a חזיין אגב אִימָּן may be handled on account of the flesh (with which they were surrounded when Sabbath cause).— Pl. אִימָּהָתָא, אִמְהָתָא. Targ. Jer. XVI, 3; esp. the arch-mothers of the Israel. nation. Targ. Y. Ex. XVII, 9; a. e.—Kid. 82 a א' דינוקי the mothers of school children. [V. also אִימָּה II.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: forma de tratamento materno; uso familiar e honorífico, conforme o contexto.
notas_originais: Imma. Y. Git. I, 43 c; Shebi VI, 36 c top א' שלום Imma (Mother) Shalom.
, v. אִמָּאוּס

notas_originais: Kel. XI, 6 (Ar. אימא, Var. עִימָּא).

Num. R. s. 9; Y. Sot. I, beg. 16 b אלא מתוך דבר של אמה (read אימה) but from a solemn conversation (v., however, Maim. Sotah IV, 18 a. comment.). R. Hash. 17 a; a. fr.— Pl. אֵימֹות. Sabb. 77 b חמש א' הן there are five sorts of fear. [Tanḥ. Tsav 2 (אימות) אימת שירוף, v. אִימּוּס.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: desfiguração; alteração ou deformação da aparência.
notas_originais: א' שירוף one disfigured by burns. Cant. R. to VII, 9 ונעשה א' ש' and he (Nebucadn.) became &c. [Tanḥ. Tsav. 2 (ed. Buber 3) ונעשה אֵימַת שירוף עליו and the fright (repulsiveness) of a burned face was put upon him. Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII אמבירוס, read אֶמְפּוּרֹוס, ἔμπυρος, fire-scathed.]
, v. אֲמַר

verbetes.glosa_atual: partes dos sacrifícios reservadas para queima sobre o altar; oferendas consagradas; emurim.
definicoes_originais: (אמר, v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.; cmp. Deut. XXVI, 17 sq.
notas_originais: ) devoted objects, sacrifices. Succ. 55 b אֲמוּרֵי הרגלים וכ' (Mish. ib. אֵימ') are not the festive Emurim (v. infra) the Lord’s, i.e. to be offered on the altar? Answ. מה שאמור ברגלים Emuré &c. means, whatever is consecrated as offering for festivals.—Esp. Emurim, Emurin, those portions of sacrifices offered on the altar. Pes. 71 a אֵימוּרֵי חגיגה וכ' the Emurim of the pilgrim’s feast offering. Zeb. II, 2; a. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: permuta; troca; plural ritual e jurídico; distinto do homógrafo sacrificial.
definicoes_originais: (מור, ימר) exchange (cmp. חליפין as to pl.).
notas_originais: בני א' hostages in place of their parents. Lam. R. to III, 13 ed. (Ar. אימְרָיָיא q. v.). V. also אֲמוּרְיָא.

verbetes.glosa_atual: ver as duas entradas precedentes אֵימוּרִים.
notas_originais: , v. preced. ws.

verbetes.glosa_atual: pessoas que se deitam logo ao anoitecer; expressão jocosa.
definicoes_originais: (= איתמ', play on מִיטָּה and אמיטתא) those who go to bed with the setting in of darkness (a witty expression made up in oppos. to שיחרין, v. שְׁחַר).
notas_originais: Ex. R. s. 47 למדו תורה דא' learn the teachings of those who rested well by night (as better fitted to teach).

verbetes.glosa_atual: leitura provavelmente corrompida para מקטרג, denunciante malicioso.
definicoes_originais: Koh. R. to II, 17, prob. a. corruption of מקטרג a malicious informer.

notas_originais: Y. Ab. Zar. I, 39 c top, they lament over it מילני אי', μέλαινα ἡμέρα, oh, the black (luckless) day! V. Macrob. Sat. I, 15 dies atri

verbetes.glosa_atual: manso; dócil; suave; domesticado, em contraste com o que é selvagem.
notas_originais: or accus.) tame, soft, gentle (opp. אַגְרִיאֹון q. v.). Gen. R. s. 77 end נמירון (corr. acc.). Num. R. s. 11; Pesik. Haḥod. p. 44 b אי מכון; Pesik. R. s. 15 אימרון; Cant. R. to III, 7 אדיבון (corr. acc.). Midr. Sam. ch. XVII (for אגריון read אימירון, for נימירון read אגריון).

definicoes_originais: (= h. מְעִיל; contr. of אימעלא; cmp. מִילְתָא) cloak.
notas_originais: Pl. אִימְלִין. Targ. Ez. XXVII, 24.

Tosef. Kel. B. Bath. II, 6 read אִימּוּם.

verbetes.glosa_atual: retratar-se; voltar atrás na afirmação; ver מרי.
cordeiro; também franja ou borda; em outro uso, topônimo Kefar Imra.
definicoes_originais: (אמר, √אם, v. אמם; cmp. עמרא, חומרא, צמר)
דהוה נכיס אמ' וכ' who slaughters a lamb and augurs from its liver.
* pr. n. pl. כפר א' K’far Imra (Lamb-ville).
notas_originais: Targ. Gen. XXX, 32; a. fr.—Ned. I, 3 ‘this be as forbidden to me כאימרא (Y. ib. I, end, 37 a כאימרה) as the lamb’—כאימר תמידא that means, ‘as the lamb of the daily offering’. Lam. R. introd. (R. Josh.

Erub. 53 b (deriding the Galilean dialect) a Galilean cried אמר למאן וכ' who wants amar? (indistinctly pronouncing the vowels, as well as the guttural sound of א), when they said to him …, חמר למירכב או חמר למשתי עמר למילבש או אימר לאיתכסאה (for var. lect., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 10) do you mean ḥ ǎmâr (an ass) to ride on, or ḥ ămar (wine) to drink, or ãmar (wool) for putting on, or immar (lamb) for slaughtering?; a. fr.— Pl. אִימְּרִין, אִימְּרַיָּא, אִימְּרַיָּיה, אִמְּ'. Ezra VII, 9; a. e.—Targ. Ex. XXIX, 38; XII, 5; a. e.—Y. Snh. I, 18 d top אי' רכיכין the lambs (of the spring) are yet tender (in a letter announcing the intercalation of a month); Bab. ib. 11 b א' עדקין (not ער'; v. Tosef. ib. II, 6); a. e.—Fem. אִימַּרְתָּא ewe. Targ. Lev. V, 6; a. e.—Ḥull. 51 a. Gen. R. s. 44 end, the sow (Rome) pastures with twenty (young ones), וא' ולא בחד and the ewe (Sarah) not even with one.—2) (cmp. חוּמְרָא) knot, bandage on wounds. Snh. 98 a כולהו שרי ואסרי אי' וכ' Ar. (in ed. a. Ms. our w. omitted) all of them untie their bandages all at once and tie them up all at once, but he attends to one at a time.
Targ. Ps. CXXXIII, 2. Targ. Y. Ex. XXVI, 4 (Var. אֶימְרָא). V. next w.
Y. Taan. IV, 69 a bot.; (Lam. R. to II, 2 נמרא).

verbetes.glosa_atual: franja; orla; bordado; vestimenta cerimonial com guarnição; adorno.
definicoes_originais: fringe, border, skirt; trnsf. the bordered garment, (toga prætexta), state garment.
trnsf. object of distinction, decoration (play on אֲמִירָה II); cmp. חְטִיבָה.
notas_originais: Taan. 11 b; Ab. Zar. 34 a חלוק לבן שאין בו אימרא a white plain frock without border (without official distinction; cmp. toga pura). Y. Kil. IX, 32 a top; Tosef. ib. V, 19 א' (ה)מפורסמת a conspicuous border garment. Y. Kid. IV, beg. 65 b (play on אִמֵּר Ezra II, 59) פירסמו וכ' they made themselves as conspicuous as the border on the frock. Sabb. 105 a; Tosef. ib. XII (XIII), 1.—Y. Yoma I, 38 d top; Y. Meg. I, 72 a bot. אִימְּרַת חלוקי the skirt of my frock; a. fr.—[Lam. R. to II, 17 explain. אִמְרָתֹו ib., פורפירא, v. בזע.] Pl. (of אוּמְּרִית) אוּמְרִיֹּות. Neg. XI, 10. Y. M. Kat. I, 80 d bot.; v. זָוַג.
Mekh. B’shall., Shirah, s. 3 (ref. to האמר־ Deut. XXVI, 17) עשאני וכ' He made me (His) decoration (chosen people) &c.; Yalk. Ex. 244 אְמִירָה.

Lam. R. to III, 13 (rendering בני אשפתו ibid. ‘the children of those thrown down’ (into the dung, conquered), Rab explains ‘the children of his destruction’ (v. אֹופִיכָא), בני אִימְרָיֵיה the children of rebellion against him. (Editions vary, אימריה, רייא …, אמורים &c., v. אֵימוּרִים II). [Esth. R. to I, 1 b, independently interpreted, v. אוּכַּיְיפָא a. אֲמוּרְיָא.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: rebelião; insurreição; forma relacionada a מרי.
definicoes_originais: (= h. מָרֹון; v. אִימַר a. preced.) rebellion.
notas_originais: בני א' rebels. R. Hash. 18 a (translating בני מרון Mish.) (all creatures pass before the Lord for receiving their decrees) כבני א' like rebels (after surrender brought before a court martial; cmp. Midr. Till. to Ps. XVII, 1, s. v. אפופסין, a. Y. R. Hash. I, 57 b). [Rashi אמרנא = Syr. אֵמרונא ‘like young lambs passing singly to be marked for tithes’.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: ovelha; fêmea ovina; também Immarta, antropônimo feminino.
notas_originais: Snh. 52 b Im. daughter of Tali (prob. pseudonyms).
17 a.—Ber. I, 1, a. fr. מאימתי from what time (of the day)? Shebi. I, 1, a. fr. עד אימתי; ib. II, 1 עד אימת how long (until when)?

verbetes.glosa_atual: quando; sempre que; forma interrogativa אֵימָתַי.
notas_originais: Targ. Y. Lev. XXIII, 42; a. e. Y. B. Kam. III, 3 d top אי' דמתיבון וכ' when they quote the Mishnah in support of &c. Ab. Zar. 53 b כל אי' דבעינא לה whenever I desire it. Nid. 66 a
VII, 4.—לא' for what time? until what time? Targ. O. Ex. VIII, 5; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: medo; temor reverente; forma aramaica de אֵימָה.
notas_originais: ch. = h. אֵימָה. Targ. O. Ex. XV, 16; a. e.—B. Kam. 28 a; a. e.
, v. אֵימָת, אֵימַת.

verbetes.glosa_atual: que inspira temor; poderoso; em outro contexto, medroso ou tímido.
notas_originais: Targ. Jud. III, 30.— Pl. אֵימְתָנִין, אֵימְתָנֵי, אֵימָ'. Targ. Ḥab. I, 7. Targ. Gen. XIV, 5 (Y. II, אמתניא, h. text אֵימִים).

Y. Meg. III, 74 a bot. ספרא הוה אימתן וכ' (ed. Krot. אימהן, corr. acc.) the school-master was a timid man and but for R. Abbahu that passed by, he would not have cleared the children out of the premises of the Synagogue. [Hebr. form, v. אֵמְתָן.]

verbetes.glosa_atual: olhar; examinar; investigar; especialmente relações de parentesco.
notas_originais: אִיֵּין (= עִיֵּין, v. next w.) to look upon, investigate. B. Bath. 115 a (play on אִין) אַיֵּין עליו Ar. (ed. עַיֵּין) investigate his family relations. Kid. 4 a

verbetes.glosa_atual: algo redondo ou decorativo; derivação relacionada à ideia de círculo.
definicoes_originais: (√או; cmp. אָוֶן, עַיִן) [b. h. naught], something rounded, decorative.
notas_originais: Koh. R. to III, 12 expl. as נֹוי, ref. to the shape of the human buttock, v. אֱפִיפְּיוֹן.

verbetes.glosa_atual: onde?; em que lugar?; usado com prefixos preposicionais.
definicoes_originais: where? (only with pref. מ or ל).
notas_originais: לְאַ' whither? מֵאַ' whence? Y. Snh. X, 28 d bot; Y. Ḥag. II, 77 a bot. מא' ולא' whence and whither?—Aboth III, 1. Gen. R. s. 2 מא' הרגלים whence art thou coming? i.e. where hast thou been staying?—Y. Snh. X, 28 b top היה לו מא' ללמוד he had (a precedent) to learn from.—Contr. of מן אין: מִנַיִן, v. מִן.

Ber. 5 a אין עוף אלא וכ' uf (flight, Job V, 7) means nothing else but &c.; a. v. fr.—אֵינִי, אֵינְךָ not I &c. אֵינִי יודע I do not know; do I not know? B. Mets. 97 b; a. fr. Ber. l. c. but the Holy One … אֵינֹו כן is not so; a. fr.—אֵינֹו דין is it not a legitimate conclusion?, whence so much the more. Y. Naz. VI, 55 a; a. v. fr.—… אין לי אלא … מניין from this I could only prove …, whence, however, will you deduct …? Ḥull. 65 b; a. fr. [Y. Git. IX, end, 50 d אפי' כתב אינו read סימנו.]

Keth. 65 a השתא א' וכ' now,—yes, but not before. B. Mets. 98 a חדא א' בעידן וכ' as regards the one (cow)—well, she died &c.; a. fr.—אֵינִי = אִין הִי is it really so? indeed?, i.e. it cannot be. Ḥull. 96 b א' והאמר it cannot be so; for did not R. … say &c.? M. Kat. 20 a; a. v. fr.

verbetes.glosa_atual: se; caso; quer... quer...; alternativamente, ou.
definicoes_originais: adv. of interrogation, introducing the alternative, or.
notas_originais: Targ. Ps. VII, 4; a. e. [Apocopated: אִי q. v.]—אין תימר (h. אם תאמר) if thou wilt say (argue). Y. Macc. II, 31 d bot.; a. fr.—אין כיני (h. אם כן היא) if this is (be) the case. Y. Naz. VI, 54 d bot.—Lam. R. introd. end אן את יתיב וכ' if thou remainest here, or &c. Koh. R. to X, 5 אן אתת ענתה וכ' if the (my dying) time comes first, what of it? and if &c.
Targ. Job VI, 6; a. e.

verbetes.glosa_atual: aquele que; quem; seguido de ד־.
definicoes_originais: c. (cmp. אִינְחוּ), followed by ד־, he who.
notas_originais: Targ. Prov. XI, 26; a. e. (also אִנָא ed.).

verbetes.glosa_atual: baga; fruto pequeno; também excrescência ocular.
definicoes_originais: (= b. h. עֵנָב q. v.) berry, an excrescence on the eye.
notas_originais: Tosef. Bekh. IV, 2. [Mish. ib. VI, 2 עֵינָב. Talm. ed. 38 ab עצב (corr. acc.).]
, v. אִנְבָּא
58 a א' פוסתא וכ' go one page and a half further, (and you will find it). [Rashi: a little = אִי־נְגַד, v. אי III.]
, v. אֶנִּיגָרֹון

notas_originais: —Ib. VII, 13 בר א' son of man (in Talm. freq. בר נש). Targ. O. Lev. XIII, 2; a. fr.—Y. Snh. VIII, 25 a bot., a. fr. כאי' דמר as if one says. Y. Ber. VIII, 12 a bot. אֲנָשָׁא רבא a great man. Shebu. 22 b; a. fr.— Pl. אֵינָשִׁין, const. אֵינָשֵׁי. Targ. O. Gen. VI, 4; a. e.—אִינְשִׁין, אִינְשֵׁי. Targ. Y. ibid.; a. e.—In Talm. mostly אִינְשֵׁי people. B. Kam. 92 b אמרי א' (text רבנן, corr. acc.). Snh. 95 b היינו דאמרי א' (abbr. ה"דא"א) this is what people say, it is a common saying (proverb). Ibid. 103 a; a. v. fr.—Git. 45 a אִינְשִׁין (our people?).

verbetes.glosa_atual: prefixo de formação nominal aramaica, com alteração da primeira consoante, comparável a formas reflexivas.
definicoes_originais: a prefix for the formation of (verbal) nouns (Ispeel nouns), affecting the first radical in the same way as the prefix of the Hithpa. or Ithpe.; e.g. from סגי, אִסְטַגְיֹות (pl.) rims; from סוַר = שור to walk, stride, אִיסְתְּוָורָא ankle, &c. Before dentals איס and אס interchange with אִיצְ־ and אִצְ־.
notas_originais: [Words not found under איס־ must be looked for under אִס־ and vice versa.]
Ex. R. s. 15, v. אִילִיאֹוס.
